hints: Picking a member at random in constant time needs the members in an array, so one can be reached by index. Which operation does that make hard?
Removing: taking a value out of the middle of an array shifts everything after it.
Unless the order does not matter - and it does not. So move the *last* element into the hole and shrink the array by one.
Finding the hole in constant time needs a map from value to its position in the array, kept up to date whenever anything moves.
